description: Upload a local PDF, JPEG/JPG or PNG (up to 10 MiB) to a staged documentId. Animated/multi-page PNG is unsupported. Check ebay_get_document for ACCEPTED. Requires sell.inventory. Local file access is opt-in: the file must sit inside a directory listed in EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_DIRS (or under EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_ROOT, which also anchors media://<relative-path> references). Symlinks are resolved before the check.

path.description: Absolute path or media:// reference inside the media allowlist

name: ebay_upload_document
